item.title: Odd Lots: How China’s Vibecoders Are Adopting AI (Podcast)
item.description: According to Stanford's AI Index, 84% of people surveyed in China say they are optimistic about AI. In the US, by contrast, 38% of those surveyed say they are optimistic. That's a big gulf in enthusiasm, and you can see it borne out in the stories you read. While in the US we hear about AI doomsday scenarios, in China you'll hear about grandmas who are obsessed with using OpenClaw.
